name: low_mode_threshold_step02
purpose: TASKS 218, GoalGathering/notes/PreRegistration_2026-11-20_Low_Mode_Repair_Threshold.md, the two-route check: the seven molecules of sample/ids_step02.txt (the smallest sampled molecule of each band, and every molecule with a registered point whose frequency noise passes 0.5 cm-1 per 1e-7 hartree/bohr of gradient noise; probes/low_mode_threshold_sample.py lists them by that rule; 15-25 atoms) patched again with a step of 0.02 bohr instead of 0.01, same threshold as the sample run, into a folder of its own. probes/low_mode_threshold_read.py --step-check flags a point whose two steps differ by more than 0.15 cm-1 (the agreement recorded at vibrations.STEP_BOHR). The corpus files are only read

estimate.basis: probes/results_m1/low_mode_threshold_2026-11-20/sample/SAMPLE.md, the step check at --below 60: 8 directions, 32 gradients and 14 reference SCFs on 7 molecules, 2.0 h at 8 threads from the median seconds per gradient of the repairs of 13-15 Nov; 4 threads assumed 1-2 times that (not measured), so 2.0-4.1 h

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops it at 4096 MB (CAP_MB); the corpus repair of 13-14 Nov peaked at 3.57 GB over 57 molecules of 8-40 atoms under the same cap, and these stop at 25 atoms
